form.oneLiner: The world's largest professional network — connect, hire, learn
form.realStory: We started in 2003 as a professional contact tool. Today 1.2 billion members use LinkedIn to connect, hire, learn, and grow their careers. The shift isn't growth — it's how. 86% of our active members are now here to learn, not just to be found.
form.customers: Professionals across every industry; recruiters at companies of every size; B2B sales teams; learners building skills
form.proof: 1.2B members across 200+ countries. 67M companies. 39K skills indexed. Microsoft acquisition validated the moat in 2016.

brandWorld.brandPersonality: Authoritative professional network — trusted, career-serious, globally inclusive, never flashy
brandWorld.visualDirection: A workspace-grade professional environment built around the LinkedIn blue system — clean white surfaces, the iconic #0A66C2 as the single load-bearing accent, structured card layouts that feel like a polished profile or feed. Typography is utilitarian and legible, density is moderate, and every element communicates credibility over cleverness.
avoid: Dark navy or black backgrounds with glowing neon accents
Heavy editorial serif typography — LinkedIn is a grotesk-led utility product
brandWorld.whyThisWorks: LinkedIn's entire visual equity lives in one blue (#0A66C2) on a white field — that's the brand, full stop. The card-and-feed layout mirrors the actual product surface professionals spend hours in daily, making the deck feel instantly native and credible to the audience.
motifs: profile card grid — photo, name, headline, connection degree
connection graph — node-and-edge people network rendered as a clean org chart, not a particle cloud
endorsement badge strips — skill tags and recommendation counts
career timeline — horizontal role progression rail
job posting tile — company logo, role title, location, applicant count
brandWorld.backgroundSystem: Warm off-white #F3F2EF page fill, white surface cards with 1px rgba border and subtle 8px drop shadow, no gradient blobs or texture
brandWorld.deckTheme: A polished LinkedIn feed and profile deck — white cards on warm off-white, #0A66C2 primary actions, Source Sans 3 throughout, career-data motifs, no decoration that doesn't earn its place
